summary: An example play that creates /etc/ansible/facts.d, copies an ipmi.fact file into it and re-runs setup with filter ansible_local so the new fact is usable in the same play. A custom facts module is more efficient if you do this often.
questions: How do I install a custom fact and use it in the same play?
How do I re-gather only local facts after adding a .fact file?
Should I use facts.d or a custom facts module for frequent use?

answer_card.title: Install a custom fact and reload it
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  tasks:
    - name: Create directory for ansible custom facts
      ansible.builtin.file:
        state: directory
        recurse: true
        path: /etc/ansible/facts.d

    - name: Install custom ipmi fact
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: ipmi.fact
        dest: /etc/ansible/facts.d

    - name: Re-read facts after adding custom fact
      ansible.builtin.setup:
        filter: ansible_local
```

If you do this a lot, a custom facts module is more efficient.
